blurb:
You’ll be guided through old town Quebec City and discover the history and see the historic sites on this smartphone navigated audio tour. Go at your own pace, anytime. Just press play to continue. The tour plays automatically as you walk creating a handfree experience., 

You’ll see the historic sites and hear the stories of the people that made this city what it is including the City Mural, the old town the walking streets the statues, overlooks, stairs, churches, buildings and so much more!
